Legal requirements for passengers (a) to form a queue in single file while waiting at a bus stop; (b) not to use obscene or offensive language or conduct themselves in a disorderly manner; (c) not to willfully remove, displace, deface a fare table or other notice in or on the bus; (d) not to smoke in a bus; (e) not to leave or attempt to leave a bus without paying the fare for the journey; (f) to retain their tickets until the end of the journey; (g) to produce their tickets to any authorized officer on demand; (h) to pay the fare for the journey taken in case they fail to produce their tickets; (i) to give priority to disabled persons to enable them to have access to their reserved seats.
